public class Solution {

    static StringTokenizer st;

    static int nextInt() throws IOException {
        while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        }
        return Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        int a = nextInt();
        int b = nextInt();
        int l = nextInt() - 1;
        int r = nextInt() - 1;
        int best = r - l + 1;
        for (char x = 'a'; x <= 'z'; x++) {

                }

        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out));
        out.println(best);
        out.flush();
    }

    private static int compute(int a, int b, int l, int r, char[] m) {
        int block = a + b;
        char[] t = new char[3 * block];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            int offset = i * block;
            char[] prefix = getPrefix(t, offset, a);
            for (int j = 0; j < a; j++) {

            for (int j = offset + a; j < offset + block; j++) {
                t[j] = m[i];
            }
        }
        int start = l % block;
        int len = r - l + 1;
        if (len < 0) throw new NegativeArraySizeException();
        int end = Math.min(t.length, start + len);
        boolean[] used = new boolean[26];
        int count = 0;
        for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
            int idx = t[i] - 'a';
            if (!used[idx]) {
                used[idx] = true;
                count++;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    private static char[] getPrefix(char[] t, int pos, int a) {
        boolean[] used = new boolean[26];
        for (int i = pos - 1; i >= 0 && i >= pos - a; i--) {
            used[t[i] - 'a'] = true;
        }
        char[] result = new char[a];
        char c = 'a';
        int idx = 0;
        while (idx < a) {
            while (used[c - 'a']) c++;
            result[idx++] = c++;
        }
        return result;
    }

public class Solution {
    static int A, B, L, R, BEST;
    static BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
    static StringTokenizer tokenizer;

    static int getInt() throws IOException {
        while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
            tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
        }
        return Integer.parseInt(tokenizer.nextToken());
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        A = getInt();
        B = getInt();
        L = getInt() - 1;
        R = getInt() - 1;
        BEST = R - L + 1;
        char[] m = new char[3];
        search(0, m);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out));
        out.println(BEST);
        out.flush();
    }

    static void search(int index, char[] m) {
        if (index == 3) {
            BEST = Math.min(BEST, score(A, B, L, R, m));
            return;
        }
        for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; c++) {
            m[index] = c;
            search(index + 1, m);
        }
    }

    static int score(int a, int b, int l, int r, char[] m) {
        int block = a + b;
        char[] t = new char[3 * block];
        for (int blockIndex = 0; blockIndex < 3; blockIndex++) {
            int base = blockIndex * block;
            char[] alpha = alphaPart(t, base, a);
            System.arraycopy(alpha, 0, t, base, a);
            Arrays.fill(t, base + a, base + block, m[blockIndex]);
        }
        int start = l % block;
        int len = r - l + 1;
        if (len < 0) throw new NegativeArraySizeException();
        int newLen = Math.min(t.length - start, len);
        Set<Character> set = new HashSet<>();
        for (int i = start; i < start + newLen; i++) {
            set.add(t[i]);
        }
        return set.size();
    }

    static char[] alphaPart(char[] t, int pos, int a) {
        boolean[] seen = new boolean[26];
        for (int i = pos - 1; i >= 0 && i >= pos - a; i--) {
            seen[t[i] - 'a'] = true;
        }
        char[] ans = new char[a];
        char next = 'a';
        int fill = 0;
        while (fill < a) {
            if (!seen[next - 'a']) {
                ans[fill++] = next;
            }
            next++;
        }
        return ans;
    }
}

public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        int[] nums = readInts();
        int a = nums[0];
        int b = nums[1];
        int l = nums[2] - 1;
        int r = nums[3] - 1;
        int best = r - l + 1;
        char[] m = new char[3];
        Arrays.fill(m, 'a');
        while (true) {
            best = Math.min(best, calc(a, b, l, r, m));
            int idx = 2;
            while (idx >= 0) {
                if (m[idx] < 'z') {
                    m[idx]++;
                    break;
                } else {
                    m[idx] = 'a';
                    idx--;
                }
            }
            if (idx < 0) break;
        }
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out));
        out.println(best);
        out.flush();
    }

    static int[] readInts() throws Exception {
        ByteArrayOutputStream buffer = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] data = new byte[8192];
        int read;
        InputStream in = System.in;
        while ((read = in.read(data)) != -1) {
            buffer.write(data, 0, read);
        }
        StringTokenizer tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(new String(buffer.toByteArray(), "UTF-8"));
        List<Integer> list = new ArrayList<>();
        while (tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
            list.add(Integer.parseInt(tokenizer.nextToken()));
        }
        int[] result = new int[list.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) result[i] = list.get(i);
        return result;
    }

    static int calc(int a, int b, int l, int r, char[] m) {
        int block = a + b;
        char[] t = new char[3 * block];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            char[] pre = buildPrefix(t, i * block, a);
            System.arraycopy(pre, 0, t, i * block, a);
            for (int j = i * block + a; j < (i + 1) * block; j++) {
                t[j] = m[i];
            }
        }
        int from = l % block;
        int len = r - l + 1;
        if (len < 0) throw new NegativeArraySizeException();
        int to = Math.min(t.length, from + len);
        int mask = 0;
        for (int i = from; i < to; i++) {
            mask |= 1 << (t[i] - 'a');
        }
        return Integer.bitCount(mask);
    }

    static char[] buildPrefix(char[] t, int pos, int a) {
        boolean[] used = new boolean[26];
        for (int i = pos - 1; i >= 0 && i >= pos - a; i--) {
            used[t[i] - 'a'] = true;
        }
        char[] p = new char[a];
        char c = 'a';
        int k = 0;
        while (k < a) {
            if (!used[c - 'a']) p[k++] = c;
            c++;
        }
        return p;
    }
}

    static int score(int a, int b, int l, int r, char[] m) {

    static char[] prefix(char[] t, int pos, int a) {

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int a = sc.nextInt();
        int b = sc.nextInt();
        int l = sc.nextInt() - 1;
        int r = sc.nextInt() - 1;
        int best = r - l + 1;
        for (int combo = 0; combo < 26 * 26 * 26; combo++) {
            char c0 = (char) ('a' + (combo / (26 * 26)));
            char c1 = (char) ('a' + ((combo / 26) % 26));
            char c2 = (char) ('a' + (combo % 26));
            best = Math.min(best, getMin(a, b, l, r, new char[]{c0, c1, c2}));
        }
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out));
        out.println(best);
        out.flush();
    }

    private static int getMin(int a, int b, int l, int r, char[] pattern) {
        int block = a + b;
        char[] t = new char[3 * block];
        for (int idx = 0; idx < 3; idx++) {
            int offset = idx * block;
            char[] generated = generate(t, offset, a);
            System.arraycopy(generated, 0, t, offset, a);
            for (int j = offset + a; j < offset + block; j++) {
                t[j] = pattern[idx];
            }
        }
        int start = l % block;
        int length = r - l + 1;
        if (length < 0) throw new NegativeArraySizeException();
        int stop = Math.min(t.length, start + length);
        BitSet bits = new BitSet(26);
        for (int i = start; i < stop; i++) {
            bits.set(t[i] - 'a');
        }
        return bits.cardinality();
    }

    private static char[] generate(char[] t, int pos, int a) {
        boolean[] used = new boolean[26];
        for (int i = pos - 1; i >= 0 && i >= pos - a; i--) {
            used[t[i] - 'a'] = true;
        }
        char[] out = new char[a];
        char ch = 'a';
        int p = 0;
        while (p < a) {
            while (used[ch - 'a']) ch++;
            out[p++] = ch++;
        }
        return out;
    }
}
